content.label: Examiner note - OILRIG and electron placement
content.body: Oxidation Is Loss, Reduction Is Gain (of electrons). At the anode, anions lose electrons - oxidation; at the cathode, cations gain them - reduction. The most common half-equation error is electrons on the wrong side: reduction adds electrons to the LEFT (reactant side). Check the charge balances as well as the atoms before you move on.
